task: Static review of plan caption placement

checks.name: Input validation and bounded work
checks.result: Layout rejects nonfinite canvas/item inputs, nonpositive caption sizes, negative reservedTop, and more than 14 markers. Each eligible caption considers eight adjacent positions and a fixed 9-by-7 fallback grid.

checks.name: Stable placement and output indexing
checks.result: Selected captions receive placement priority; equal selection priority resolves by input index. Fallbacks sort by Euclidean anchor distance, resolving equal distance by original enumeration index. Frame arrays retain input order.

checks.name: Caption boundary and collision filtering
checks.result: A candidate must stay within eight-point horizontal/bottom margins and max(8,reservedTop) at the top. It must avoid every marker frame and every previously placed caption by the four-point clearance supplied to Rect.intersects. Marker frames preserve supplied anchor centers.

checks.name: Larger caption boxes
checks.result: Caption dimensions are used unchanged; oversized or unplaceable captions remain explicitly nil. Enlarged boxes continue through the same boundary/collision filtering, without shrinking or displacing markers.

checks.name: Regression test coverage
checks.result: Read all six methods. They check the prior captured caption/icon collision; widths 160, 240, 342 and 700 with text scales 1, 1.5, 2.5 and 3.2; repeated-layout equality; coincident markers and selected priority; oversized omission; invalid inputs/count limit; and empty/tiny layouts. Shared assertions inspect frame dimensions, anchor preservation, margins and marker/caption separation. No method was executed.

checks.name: Acceptance alignment
checks.result: M03 requires real app semantics and default/largest-text layout evidence. This helper and its synthetic box assertions provide relevant source-level coverage, but do not by themselves establish rendered glyph fit or native/UI acceptance.

conclusion: No concrete correctness defect found within the two-file placement scope. Report is static review evidence only.
